## What is nutrition counseling?

Nutrition counseling is behavioral support for people managing their weight, delivered by licensed therapists and registered dietitians. It looks at the habits, triggers and coping skills around food rather than the medical procedure itself. At the Bariatric Counseling Center we provide it through group and individual therapy, dietary guidance, cooking classes and movement education in one Intensive Outpatient Program. Clients attend onsite at our San Antonio facility or virtually from anywhere in Texas, and the program is in network with most health insurance plans. It can stand alone or sit alongside the care a client receives from a surgeon or medical provider.
